blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution’s forensic accounting expert witness, lawyer-accountant Alexander Cabrera, stood by his finding on Monday that Vice President Sara Duterte had a 20-percent interest in GenCorp Industries Inc., even without written contracts or subscription agreements directly establishing her stake in the firm. Cabrera, chairman emeritus of Isla Lipana & Co. (PwC Philippines), defended his findings during cross-examination by defense counsel Kristine Ferrer on the 38th day of Duterte’s Senate impeachment trial. Ferrer had asked whether the 20-percent interest attributed to Duterte was supported by any deed of assignment, deed of subscription, or subscription agreement examined by Cabrera’s team. […]...
